entity.name: Site Management Sector - Cox's Bazar / Site Planning and Development Taskforce

lineage.description: Road features within the Kutupalong-Balukhali Rohingya refugee sites were digitized by combining multiple sources: Site Planning and Development taskforce data, UAV satellite imagery captured on 25 April, GPS tracks collected in the field, and OpenStreetMap contributions. The resulting shapefile classifies roads by type (vehicle road, main path, footpath, military-constructed, and planned) to support site management and humanitarian logistics planning.
